answer: Because the marble calculation reruns each epoch, the falcon weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the atlas settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 62% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A tight ring of 167 clones therefore holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent.
